# Reproducibility

<!-- generated by scripts/make_reproducibility.py from results/*/record.json -->

One command reproduces every reported result (quick profile):

```bash
python scripts/reproduce_all.py --profile quick
```

Each experiment writes `results/<id>/` with `record.json` (all spec Section 13 fields, including the hypothesis written before the run, seed, git commit, software versions and hardware), `config.yaml` where applicable, `metrics.json`, `history.csv` and `git_hash.txt`. Pinned versions: `constraints.txt`.

Notes: several studies shared the 4 CPU cores concurrently, so wall-clock times are upper bounds for an idle machine. GPU was not available. Colab/Kaggle notebooks in `notebooks/` were generated but not executed. Determinism: seeds fixed; CPU runs are bit-reproducible (tests/test_ml.py::test_determinism_and_serialisation, tests/test_validation_engine.py).
